title: The token state of play
gist: Gateway data on who serves what. Open-weight models have carried most tokens since April while closed models still take most of the money, and a new premium closed model pulls spend back within weeks. A second gateway reports the same pattern.
changes: Coexistence, measured: volume goes to open models and money to closed ones. For a provider of open models this is the market, most of the tokens and a quarter of the spend.
caveats: One gateway's developer-heavy traffic, with token and spend figures from different weeks. The second gateway's index corroborates the direction, not the exact shares.

numbers.baseline: under half at the start of the year

numbers.metric: Open-weight share on a second gateway

bears_on.note: Both kinds of model carry real traffic at once, split by volume and by money.
The average start-up on the gateway uses 12 models and more than half changed their top model in a month.
